{
  "process": "Each row represents a patient with cardiac failure who is enrolled in a cohort, undergoes baseline clinical assessment and laboratory testing, is then followed over time for vital status, and the outcome mortality_event is recorded when the patient dies or is censored at the end of follow-up.",
  "target_known_at": "death or censoring event (end of follow-up)",
  "prediction_point": "baseline assessment at enrollment, before any follow-up occurs",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "lv_ejection_pct", "event": "baseline echocardiogram", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "cpk_level", "event": "baseline blood draw", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "sodium_level", "event": "baseline blood draw", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "creatinine_level", "event": "baseline blood draw", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "sex_recorded", "event": "patient enrollment (demographic record)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98},
    {"name": "dm_flag", "event": "patient enrollment (medical history)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "patient_age", "event": "patient enrollment (age at baseline)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98},
    {"name": "hypertension_flag", "event": "patient enrollment (medical history)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "obs_days", "event": "end of follow-up (death or censoring)", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96},
    {"name": "anemia_flag", "event": "patient enrollment (baseline labs or history)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "smoker_flag", "event": "patient enrollment (history)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96},
    {"name": "platelet_count", "event": "baseline blood draw", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95}
  ]
}
